permissionAndConcurrencyChecks: Student MOBILE-only narrow routes, strict bounded parameters and explicit safe DTO; other students and generic web/teacher endpoints remain denied
Only own records in currently authorized courses are listed; inactive/closed questions hide body and all recursive answer/feedback fields; existing own favorites can still be removed
Mastery token covers current flag, wrong count and last answer time; conditional SQL update rejects a newer answer or state without overwriting it
Favorite record identity protects removal after deletion/recreation; concurrent equivalent additions produce one record with conflicts requiring refresh
Web and native manual collection changes share advisory transactions and refresh session, learning permission, course authorization and organization feature flag after acquiring the lock
Actual queued PostgreSQL locks with enrollment, practice flag and device session withdrawn before release reject all stale writes

Native mutation confirmation can be cancelled, navigation cannot reuse a stale confirmation, in-flight duplicates are blocked, and uncertain results require successful read-only reload without automatic replay

Dedicated real database/API tests cover privacy, pagination, shared website state, stale flags/new answers, duplicate favorites/recreated identity, closed questions, committed response loss and queued revocation

Full native journey adds mastery confirmation/cancel, filtering, changed answer conflict, favorites, closed question removal and pagination to every prior native course/media/planner/assignment/exam/review/notification/note/practice/live/session check
resolvedDuringAcceptance: First full run failed official Expo SDK compatibility validation because five compatible patch releases had appeared; it was stopped after that known failure. Expo, linking, router, sharing and splash-screen were updated to recommended SDK56 patches, explicit splash plugin configured, security fingerprints rechecked, both APKs rebuilt and the default full gate rerun. No dependency check was excluded.

Native acceptance initially refused an existing preview reverse-port mapping left by the previous delivered version. Only the two owned emulator preview mappings were removed before a clean rerun; original website and services were retained.
limits: This round migrates personal mistake/favorite management only; AI learning, algorithms, programming, specialist study, communication and administration remain on the published pending migration list
Practice navigation opens the authorized course configuration; it does not preselect a mode or automatically create a practice session
Mastery is a manual personal flag, not an inferred learning score; its token compares current state/history rather than a monotonic revision
No offline records, persistent unsubmitted input, system notifications or AI calls were added
Server must deploy the new APIs; no additional schema migration. Local and production identities/data remain independent
Android12 arm64 emulator uses real local API/PostgreSQL/LiveKit and synthetic cameras, host microphone disabled; physical device, Bluetooth, cellular, weak network and TURN checks remain separate
Preview APKs use a public Android debug signing key, are bundled and non-debuggable with backups disabled; HTTPS preview forbids cleartext. No store release or iOS build
Inherited mobile build advisories remain visible with fingerprinted backports; raw npm audit is not zero. No unmitigated advisory accepted
privacy: Disposable local fixtures only; no paid AI/Judge calls, production changes, credentials, environment files, private config or databases included
